senses.gloss:
Journey,Ⓒs.ⒹprayARaM, prasTAnaM, pravAsaH, yAtrA, deSaBramaRaM-paryawanaM, aDvan m., mArgaH, aDva or mArga-gamanaM or kramaRaM, ‘on account of the fatigues of j(ourney)’ aDvasaMjAtaKedAt; utTAya punaravahat (Ka. 299). ‘resumed his j(ourney)’ &c.; ‘it is only a weekʼs j(ourney)’ saptAhaga-myo'DvA; ‘to return from a j(ourney)’ pravAsAd upAni-vft 1 A; ‘may the j(ourney) be pleasant to you’ SivAste paMTAnaH saMtu.
Ⓔv. i.Ⓓpra-yA 2 P, mArgeRa gam or vraj or car 1 P or yA, paryaw 1 P, pariBram 1, 4 P, vah 1 P, divA rAtrO cAvahat (Ka. 301); ‘to j(ourney) abroad’ pravas 1 P.
Ⓝ[Journey]er,Ⓒs.ⒹaDvagaH, paTikaH, pAMTaH, yAtrikaH.
ⓃJourneyman,Ⓒs.ⒹvEtanikaH, hastakarmakAraH.
